query: 帮我查一下上个月的订单情况

outcome.sql: SELECT "o"."order_id" AS "order_id", "o"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "o"."amount" AS "amount", "o"."cost_price" AS "cost_price", "o"."status" AS "status", TO_CHAR("o"."order_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "order_date", "o"."region" AS "region" FROM "public"."orders" "o" WHERE "o"."order_date" >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month')::date AND "o"."order_date" < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date ORDER BY "o"."order_date" ASC LIMIT 40
